snippet.title: New Delhi Community Radio
snippet.description:
New Delhi Community Radio (NDCR) is an artist-led platform broadcasting experimental music, DJ sets, and underground sounds from India and beyond. Rooted in New Delhi, we champion deep listening, cultural exchange, and sonic storytelling — free from algorithms and gatekeeping.

Subscribe for genre-fluid sets, live performances, takeovers, and archives from South Asia’s most exciting emerging voices.

snippet.description:

snippet.title: NDCR #078: Jaag | Breaks, Electro, Acid & Trance | 24th Sep 2026
snippet.description:
Jaag, aka Neha, is a San Francisco Bay Area based DJ weaving together different genres into cohesive, rhythmic journeys built around liberation, joy, and connection.

Drawing from the genre-bending South Asian producers of the 90s, the hyphy movement of the 2000s, and the vocal traditions of Carnatic music, her sets move through breaks, electro, leftfield bass, trance, acid, and global percussion.

Alongside fellow SF DJ Nofi, she also runs Maja Blast, a genre-less, set-time-less party series built around immersive experiences and musical discovery. Whether through clubs, community gatherings, or radio, Jaag uses DJing as a way to connect overlooked sounds, trace musical lineages, and bring diverse influences into the same space.

For NDCR #078, Jaag takes us on a genre-fluid journey through rhythm, texture, bass, and percussion.

snippet.title: CR #070: GLM B2B The Untitled One | Drum & Bass, UK Garage & 140 | 30 July 2026
snippet.description:
GLM is a boundary-pushing producer and DJ whose sound moves effortlessly between techy UK garage, 140, and rolling drum & bass. Unrestricted by genre or tempo, his productions combine intricate rhythms with rich atmospheres, earning releases on labels including 1985 Music and Flexout Audio, alongside a residency on SWU.fm. Drawing from the full spectrum of underground club culture, GLM crafts immersive, forward-thinking sets that blur stylistic boundaries while keeping energy and emotion at their core.

Joining him is The Untitled One, one of India's pioneering drum & bass DJs and the co-founder of Drum and Bass India. Through his long-running Sub-Titles radio show on Boxout.fm, influential club nights, and years of championing emerging talent, he has played a defining role in shaping the country's bass music community. Renowned for his high-energy selections and unwavering commitment to the scene, he continues to push Indian drum & bass forward through performance, curation, and community-building.

Together, GLM and The Untitled One deliver a high-intensity B2B that moves between UK garage, 140, and drum & bass with precision, deep selections, and relentless energy.

A Hyderabad-based DJ, ADIDAMIX takes her name from the phrase "I did a mix"—a philosophy that extends far beyond music. Blending broken beats, left-field house, baile funk, dubby textures, and heavy low-end grooves, her sets are bold, playful, and deeply immersive, reflecting an open-minded approach to both music and community.

A lawyer by profession but a rule-breaker behind the decks, ADIDAMIX crafts dancefloors where confidence, connection, and experimentation thrive. snippet.title: NDCR #068: Anderson1000 B2B Von Riu | Progressive House, Trance, Breaks & Bass | 16 July 2026
snippet.description:
Paris-based DJ, producer, and founder of the Gl.o.bal label, Von Riu is known for seamlessly blending progressive house, trance, breaks, and bass into meticulously crafted sets. With an instinctive approach to crowd control, he moves fluidly between genres in search of the perfect balance between artistic expression and dancefloor energy. His journey has taken him to renowned clubs and festivals across Europe, Asia, and South America, including Shenzhen's iconic Oil Club and Rio Carnival's Kodefervo, while his productions continue to receive support from artists such as Roza Terenzi, Mama Snake, Anetha, and Salome.

Joining him is Anderson1000, a French DJ and producer whose immersive sound traverses tribal techno, surgical breaks, and haunting textures, creating hypnotic journeys filled with tension, mystery, and groove. Constructed through long, deliberate transitions and cinematic atmospheres, his sets unfold like carefully paced narratives, balancing organic rhythms with intricate sound design. Constantly evolving behind the decks and in the studio, Anderson1000 crafts deeply atmospheric experiences that blur the line between introspective listening and powerful dancefloor moments.

Together, they deliver a B2B that brings two distinct yet complementary approaches to contemporary club music.

Premiering now on NDCR.

snippet.title: NDCR #078: Jaag | Breaks, Electro, Acid & Trance | 24th Sep 2026
snippet.description:
Jaag, aka Neha, is a San Francisco Bay Area based DJ weaving together different genres into cohesive, rhythmic journeys built around liberation, joy, and connection.

Drawing from the genre-bending South Asian producers of the 90s, the hyphy movement of the 2000s, and the vocal traditions of Carnatic music, her sets move through breaks, electro, leftfield bass, trance, acid, and global percussion.

Alongside fellow SF DJ Nofi, she also runs Maja Blast, a genre-less, set-time-less party series built around immersive experiences and musical discovery. Whether through clubs, community gatherings, or radio, Jaag uses DJing as a way to connect overlooked sounds, trace musical lineages, and bring diverse influences into the same space.

For NDCR #078, Jaag takes us on a genre-fluid journey through rhythm, texture, bass, and percussion.

snippet.title: NDCR #071: KAMPAI | Global Club, UK Garage, Baile Funk & Bass Music | 06 August 2026
snippet.description:
KAMPAI is the solo project of Bengaluru-based DJ, curator, and entrepreneur Rumit Virmani, known for high-energy sets that seamlessly move between global sounds, UK garage, house, baile funk, dubstep, and drum & bass. Blending rare edits and unreleased dubs, his genre-fluid approach is always driven by groove and built for the dancefloor.

Following standout performances at Mixmag Lab and Boiler Room, Kampai has become one of India's most sought-after selectors, sharing lineups with leading international acts while touring across Australia, the UK, Europe, Southeast Asia, the UAE, and Nepal.

Beyond the decks, he's the founder of Body Language and co-founder of SoMAD Fest, playing a key role in shaping India's contemporary club culture through over a decade of curation, programming, and community building.

For NDCR #071, KAMPAI delivers a high-energy journey through global club sounds, weaving together UK garage, house, baile funk, dubstep, and drum & bass with the precision and instinct that have made him one of the country's defining selectors.

snippet.title: CR #070: GLM B2B The Untitled One | Drum & Bass, UK Garage & 140 | 30 July 2026
snippet.description:
GLM is a boundary-pushing producer and DJ whose sound moves effortlessly between techy UK garage, 140, and rolling drum & bass. Unrestricted by genre or tempo, his productions combine intricate rhythms with rich atmospheres, earning releases on labels including 1985 Music and Flexout Audio, alongside a residency on SWU.fm. Drawing from the full spectrum of underground club culture, GLM crafts immersive, forward-thinking sets that blur stylistic boundaries while keeping energy and emotion at their core.

Joining him is The Untitled One, one of India's pioneering drum & bass DJs and the co-founder of Drum and Bass India. Through his long-running Sub-Titles radio show on Boxout.fm, influential club nights, and years of championing emerging talent, he has played a defining role in shaping the country's bass music community. Renowned for his high-energy selections and unwavering commitment to the scene, he continues to push Indian drum & bass forward through performance, curation, and community-building.

Together, GLM and The Untitled One deliver a high-intensity B2B that moves between UK garage, 140, and drum & bass with precision, deep selections, and relentless energy.

snippet.title: NDCR #069: ADIDAMIX | Broken Beats, Left-field House, Baile Funk & Bass | 23 July 2026
snippet.description:
ADIDAMIX joins the NDCR airwaves for NDCR #069.

A Hyderabad-based DJ, ADIDAMIX takes her name from the phrase "I did a mix"—a philosophy that extends far beyond music. Blending broken beats, left-field house, baile funk, dubby textures, and heavy low-end grooves, her sets are bold, playful, and deeply immersive, reflecting an open-minded approach to both music and community.

A lawyer by profession but a rule-breaker behind the decks, ADIDAMIX crafts dancefloors where confidence, connection, and experimentation thrive. Her selections embrace groove as the common thread, representing a new generation of selectors unafraid to push boundaries while keeping the dancefloor firmly in focus.

snippet.title: NDCR #068: Anderson1000 B2B Von Riu | Progressive House, Trance, Breaks & Bass | 16 July 2026
snippet.description:
Paris-based DJ, producer, and founder of the Gl.o.bal label, Von Riu is known for seamlessly blending progressive house, trance, breaks, and bass into meticulously crafted sets. With an instinctive approach to crowd control, he moves fluidly between genres in search of the perfect balance between artistic expression and dancefloor energy. His journey has taken him to renowned clubs and festivals across Europe, Asia, and South America, including Shenzhen's iconic Oil Club and Rio Carnival's Kodefervo, while his productions continue to receive support from artists such as Roza Terenzi, Mama Snake, Anetha, and Salome.

Joining him is Anderson1000, a French DJ and producer whose immersive sound traverses tribal techno, surgical breaks, and haunting textures, creating hypnotic journeys filled with tension, mystery, and groove. Constructed through long, deliberate transitions and cinematic atmospheres, his sets unfold like carefully paced narratives, balancing organic rhythms with intricate sound design. Constantly evolving behind the decks and in the studio, Anderson1000 crafts deeply atmospheric experiences that blur the line between introspective listening and powerful dancefloor moments.

Together, they deliver a B2B that brings two distinct yet complementary approaches to contemporary club music.

Premiering now on NDCR.

snippet.title: NDCR #067: BINDAS | Afro Desi, Baile, UK Funky, UKG & Global Bass | 9 July 2026
snippet.description:
NDCR #067 welcomes Bindas, a London-based DJ and curator exploring diasporic sounds and global club rhythms.

For the past year, Bindas has been curating the Silky Road Tour show on Brixton Radio, using the platform to explore sounds rooted across the Global South and beyond. Her selections move through a wide spectrum of bass-heavy and percussive styles, including Afro Desi edits, Batida, Miami Bass, UK Funky, UK Garage, Baile, and Jersey Club.

Known for navigating unexplored musical territories while keeping her sets familiar, energetic, and groove-driven, Bindas brings together sounds from different cultures and scenes into a fluid global club experience. Recently hand-picked by Lady Shaka to open for her Phonox show in London, she continues to establish herself as an emerging voice within the city's underground music community.

For her NDCR session, Bindas delivers a journey through global bass, rhythmic club sounds, and diasporic influences connecting scenes, cultures, and movements through music.

snippet.title: NDCR #065: SourOG | Jungle, Breakbeat, Bass & UK Sounds | 26 June 2026
snippet.description:
SourOG joins New Delhi Community Radio for NDCR #065, bringing a sound rooted in old-school influences, bass-heavy rhythms and deeply personal storytelling.

A longtime devotee of bass music, SourOG crafts journey-like sets woven from the genres that have shaped her musical identity. For her, sound has always been more than entertainment—it's a language for translating emotion, expressing the unspoken, and connecting with experiences that words often fail to capture.

For NDCR #065, SourOG delivers a deeply considered journey through bass, breaks and old-school club sounds, balancing nostalgia with forward-thinking selection.

snippet.title: NDCR #064: FUSHI | Bass, Leftfield Club, UK Bass & Global Club | 19 June 2026
snippet.description:
FUSHI is a South Asian DJ known for blending rhythm-heavy bass music with leftfield club sounds into dynamic, high-energy sets shaped by movement, experimentation and club culture.

A key member of the 4NC¥ collective since its inception, FUSHI has built a strong presence across India's underground electronic music scene, performing in Bangalore, Goa, Kochi, Delhi, Chennai and Pondicherry. Their journey has included appearances at Bangalore Massive, Dance OK Please, Circle Of Love and Warehouse Project, while sharing lineups with artists including DJ Oblig, Jyoty, Nastia and Operate.

Beyond the dancefloor, FUSHI has contributed mixes to platforms including Durian Radio (Bangkok), Subtle Radio (UK), 8ball Radio (New York) and Wavlngth (India), expanding their reach across international community radio networks. Their debut 4NC¥ Radio mix, Mallipu, introduced a distinctive blend of bass-driven club music and leftfield electronics, while their ongoing Mixcloud series, Resistance Tape, continues to explore new sonic territories.

For NDCR #064, FUSHI delivers a powerful session moving through bass, leftfield club sounds and forward-thinking electronic music with precision, energy and depth.

snippet.title: NDCR #059: MOWGLI | UKG, Grime, Baile Funk & Global Club | 14 May 2026
snippet.description:
MOWGLI arrives at Delhi Community Radio with a set that captures the energy, versatility and sharp selection that have made him one of the most exciting selectors to emerge from Australia.

Fuelled by his South Asian roots and a deep connection to global club culture, MOWGLI has built his sound through genre fluidity and instinctive track selection, moving seamlessly between UKG, grime, baile funk, jungle and bass-driven club music.

His sets have taken him across multiple Asia tours as well as stages in Argentina, Bali and throughout Australia. Along the way, he has shared bills with artists including Oppidan, Fred again.., Jyoty, DJ Habibeats, Panjabi MC and Yung Singh, further cementing his growing international presence.

Beyond the decks, his collaborative edits and remixes have amassed over 400K streams on SoundCloud, earning support and co-signs from selectors across the globe.

As co-founder of KERFEW, a collective dedicated to uplifting South Asian creatives across Australia, MOWGLI continues to push his sound and community-driven vision onto the global dance music circuit.

For NDCR #059, MOWGLI delivers a high-energy session packed with rhythmic pressure, bass-heavy movement and genre-crossing club energy.

snippet.title: NDCR #058: Alienata | Electro, Acid, Industrial & Techno
snippet.description:
Spanish-born DJ and producer Alienata has been shaping her path between techno and electro since the mid-2000s, developing a sound that is fluid, driving and resistant to fixed definition. Based in Berlin since 2012, her approach draws from Detroit’s depth, Chicago’s rhythmic energy and the edge of UK techno, weaving together raw electro, acid and industrial textures into dynamic, tension-driven sets.

A regular at Berghain and Tresor, as well as across international clubs and festivals, she has built a distinctive presence that bridges scenes and sensibilities through powerful, high-intensity performances.

With releases on Killekill, Cultivated Electronics and Machine, alongside Discos Atónicos — the label she founded in 2017 — her trajectory continues to evolve across production, curation and club culture.

Her debut solo EP, set for release in 2026, marks a new chapter in an already deeply rooted trajectory.

For NDCR #058, Alienata delivers a driving session moving through electro, acid and industrial-infused techno with precision, tension and momentum.

snippet.title: NDCR #057: Sublime Sound Live | Live, Experimental, Breakbeat & Electronica | 23 Apr 2026
snippet.description:
Sublime Sound is the solo project of New Delhi-based producer and performer Anhad Khanna, blending experimental textures with melodic, emotionally driven soundscapes. His music and DJ sets reflect a deep personal connection to every record he plays, balancing introspection with movement.

As one of the most versatile rising acts in the circuit, he debuted on UK label Remmah Records with That Love Affair — a synth-heavy, breakbeat-driven EP that received strong radio support. His sound moves fluidly between live performance and club contexts, shaped by a dynamic and evolving approach to electronic music.

He has performed at festivals such as Jika Jika (alongside Kerri Chandler) and Lollapalooza India, with upcoming international shows including Glasgow’s Sub Club. Beyond performance, he curates Feels Like Future, a club night and conversation series exploring dance music and alternative arts.

Also one half of Indo-American duo Anhad + Tanner, he has released the albums In Other Words (2020) and Still But Moving (2024), further expanding his sonic identity across formats.

This set was recorded live by NDCR on 20th February 2026 at Cosy Box Delhi, covering the event DAISUKI as a broadcasting partner.

For NDCR #057, Sublime Sound delivers a deeply immersive live session, weaving emotion, texture and rhythm into a fluid, expressive journey.

snippet.title: NDCR #056: Mr. Disco Kid | Vinyl, Disco, House & Global Grooves
snippet.description:
Mr. Disco Kid began his journey as a DJ and private record dealer in his teens, developing a deep-rooted understanding of vinyl culture early on. With an expansive knowledge of records, he has honed a distinctive ability to curate across a wide spectrum of sounds — from rare and obscure grooves to house, techno and global rhythms.

His sets are tied together by a signature groove-driven sensibility and a genre-transcending musical vision, balancing deep digging with a strong connection to the dancefloor.

In 2024 and 2025, he embarks on a European DJ tour, further solidifying his presence on the international circuit. A standout moment includes a remarkable 7-hour set at Giant Steps in London, followed by consecutive all-night-long sessions at the same venue across both years — a testament to his depth, stamina and control behind the decks.

Beyond the booth, his work as a record dealer has earned him a respected clientele including Gilles Peterson, Tuxedo and Antal. Driven by a passion for discovery, he is dedicated to uncovering hidden gems, creating new value around them and sharing these sounds with audiences worldwide.

This set was recorded live by NDCR on 20th February 2026 at Cosy Box Delhi, covering the event DAISUKI as a broadcasting partner.

For NDCR #056, Mr. Disco Kid delivers a deep, groove-led session rooted in vinyl culture and long-form storytelling.

snippet.title: NDCR #053: Maggie Tra | Leftfield, Bass, Club, Experimental | 19 March 2026
snippet.description:
NDCR #053 features Maggie Tra — an Australian-born Vietnamese Cambodian producer, DJ, and label head crafting immersive electronic journeys shaped by melody, groove, and genre-fluid club rhythms.

Blending Asian influences with contemporary dance music, her sound moves seamlessly across tempos and textures, creating captivating, time-suspending moments on the dancefloor.

Since her debut EP U.L.A (U Look Asian) in 2021, Maggie Tra has continued to evolve her sonic identity through projects including Kingdom of Her (2022), Very Vui (2023), and Dancing Untethered (2024), earning support from platforms such as Triple J, NTS, Mixmag Asia, and Worldwide FM. Her releases span labels including Shika Shika Collective and FuFu Records, while her work as founder of SYS Sister Sounds and Hà Nội Community Radio reflects a deep commitment to community-building and amplifying women and non-binary artists across global scenes.

With performances spanning India to Berlin and appearances at platforms such as SXSW Sydney, Maggie Tra continues to push the boundaries of contemporary club music while centering Asian voices and perspectives.

For NDCR #053, she delivers a dynamic, genre-fluid session that moves between bass-driven energy, melodic passages, and experimental club textures.

snippet.title: NDCR #052: Nida x Citizen Kale | House, Global Club, Funk | 12 March 2026
snippet.description:
NDCR #052 features a special B2B set from Nida of New Delhi Community Radio and Citizen Kale of Planet Kale, recorded following their first-ever offline pop-up collaboration in Mumbai.

Hosted on 21 February at Mag Street Kitchen in collaboration with Off Menu, the event marked a milestone for both platforms — bringing together two independent radio communities from New Delhi and Bombay for their first offline collaboration.

The evening also marked New Delhi Community Radio’s debut show in Mumbai, celebrating a shared commitment to community-led broadcasting and cross-city cultural exchange.

For the night’s closing set, founders Nida and Citizen Kale stepped behind the decks together, blending their distinct musical sensibilities into a dynamic B2B session that moved fluidly across club sounds and leftfield selections.

NDCR #052 captures that moment — a meeting of two communities, two cities, and a shared vision for independent radio and dancefloor culture.

snippet.title: NDCR #051: Kaleekarma | Electronic, DnB , House, Experimental | 5 March 2026
snippet.description:
NDCR #051 welcomes Kaleekarma — a storyteller at heart, using music to weave theatrical journeys through organic, ethnic, retro, acid, and folk-tinged soundscapes.

Beginning with intimate house-party sets in 2012, Kaleekarma has steadily grown into one of India’s respected underground selectors. Her sets unfold with a cinematic flow, moving from meditative and unhurried passages into moments of intensity and otherworldly energy, reflecting years of experimentation and intention behind the decks.

Over the years, she has shared her sound on platforms such as Boxout.fm, Wild City, and Worldwide.fm, while hosting her own show Kindled Love on Boxout.fm — a space dedicated to exploring slower, deeper, and more experimental musical territories.

With performances across major Indian cities and an international debut in Mauritius, Kaleekarma has also appeared at festivals including Magnetic Fields, Celtronic, and STIHLIA, sharing stages with artists such as Four Tet, Ben UFO, and HVOB.

For NDCR #051, Kaleekarma delivers a richly textured session that unfolds patiently — guiding listeners through shifting moods, layered rhythms, and immersive sonic landscapes.

snippet.title: NDCR #050: MC Soopy | House, Garage, Techno | 26 February 2026
snippet.description:
Soopy is a New Delhi–based DJ known for his versatile, genre-fluid approach that seamlessly blends hip hop, house, amapiano, and Afrobeats. With an instinctive ability to read and energize crowds, he has become a sought-after presence across clubs, festivals, and curated brand showcases.

His journey includes performances at some of India’s leading music festivals, including Magnetic Fields and VH1 Supersonic, alongside curated events for Uniqlo India, Polo Ralph Lauren, WeWork, and Bumble India. A regular fixture in Delhi’s nightlife, Soopy holds residencies at PCO Delhi and Fio, while also hosting his biweekly radio show The Heatcheck on Boxout.fm, where he showcases his dynamic range as both DJ and emcee.

For NDCR #050, Soopy brings a rhythm-forward session built on fluid transitions — moving between hip hop bounce, amapiano grooves, and Afro-inflected house energy with confidence and control.

snippet.title: NDCR #048: Blu Attic | Deep House, Melodic Techno, Progressive | 12 February 2026
snippet.description:
Blu Attic is a New Delhi–based producer, DJ, and pianist emerging as a distinct voice within India’s electronic music landscape. Blending melody, atmosphere, and Indian influence into modern house and techno, his sound is rooted in classical and jazz piano foundations, resulting in music that is textured, emotional, and immersive.

With releases on labels including Anjunadeep Explorations, Indo Warehouse, Sekora, Songspire, and Movement Recordings — including the acclaimed Till I Lose Myself and the Traces EP — Blu Attic has earned support from BBC Radio 1 and shared stages with artists such as Dosem, Fehrplay, and Nordfold. His touring highlights include performances across India and internationally, including a headline set at Terra Solis Dubai for Indo Warehouse and Tomorrowland.

Known for narrative-driven sets that move fluidly from deep house to melodic techno, Blu Attic joins NDCR for a warm, intentional session built on melody, progression, and dancefloor storytelling.

snippet.title: NDCR #047: BIG M | House, UKG, Disco | 5 February 2026
snippet.description:
Mrunal Shah, aka BIG M, is a Mumbai-based DJ and curator whose sound is rooted in soulful house while drawing freely from UKG, jungle, hip-hop, disco, and beyond. Influenced by the greats of house and garage, his sets blend deep musical knowledge with a playful, dancer-first energy built for long-form listening and movement.

In 2020, he launched Q-Radio — an online radio platform born during lockdown that has since grown into a community-driven space for emerging DJs and music lovers to connect, share, and explore new sounds.

Whether behind the decks or curating platforms, BIG M continues to bring people together through groove, swing, and bumping basslines. This session for NDCR captures his fluid approach to dance music, balancing warmth, rhythm, and dancefloor intent.

snippet.description:

With releases on Monkeytown, Turbo, REKIDS and an ongoing relationship with Laurent Garnier’s COD3 QR, Works Of Intent has become a distinctive voice in contemporary club music. snippet.description:
Sid Praja is a Jodhpur-born, Jaipur-based DJ, producer, and curator whose journey through electronic music has been entirely self-taught. His sets weave together house, techno, IDM, and electro—creating therapeutic, versatile soundscapes that move between reflection and intensity.

In 2023, Sid released his debut EP Krystle on Karachi’s Cape Monze Records, earning support from names like Tomoki Tamura, Beatrice M., Doctor Jeep, Polygonia, and Amor Satyr. His track Cosmopolitan appeared on DJ Babatr’s Raptor House compilation, while No More Genocide was featured on India’s influential platform Wild City.

Now based in Jaipur, Sid is a driving force in the local underground, curating his monthly residency DUI, which has quickly become a hub for innovative and forward-thinking sounds.

snippet.title: NDCR x DNCR | 📍STRANGR DELHI Takeover Highlights #housemusic #collab
snippet.description:
On June 27th, NDCR x DNCR brought the heat to Strangr Delhi with a night that was all about music, community, and high-energy vibes.💃🏻

snippet.title: NDCR #010: RAFIKI | Acid, Breaks, House, Techno | June 5, 2025
snippet.description:
Rafiki is the genre-blurring alias of Sohail Arora — producer, selector, and founder of KRUNK. Based in Mumbai, he fuses acid, breaks, house, and techno with over 15 years of curatorial depth. In 2023 & 2024, he dropped acclaimed releases on Welt Discos & Permanent Vacation respectively, with features on Pitchfork, BBC Radio 6, COLORS, and more. A Mixmag “Artist to Watch,” he’s played across India and Europe, including Boiler Room, Outlook Origins, and Magnetic Fields. Whether behind the decks or in the studio, Rafiki pushes the underground forward with bold, boundary-breaking sound.He’s also part of Redline DJs, a fierce tag team with unmatched energy behind the booth. With a 2025 EU tour on the horizon and a massive Glastonbury debut, Rafiki continues to expand his global footprint.

 #Acid #Breaks #House #Techno

snippet.title: NDCR #007: DJ MOCITY | UKG, Electronica, Afro, Bass | May 15, 2025 | @DJMoCityTV
snippet.description:
A boundary-blurring selector and sonic storyteller, DJ MoCity navigates global frequencies with deep intention. Co-founder of Boxout.fm, South Asia’s pioneering community radio station, MoCity has been instrumental in shaping India’s independent music infrastructure. 

From vinyl-only sets at HoneyComb Hi-Fi to headline slots at Boiler Room India and Art Dubai, his performances channel Middle Eastern roots through a contemporary lens. 

With projects like Iraqi & Arabic Edits Vol. 2 and residencies on Worldwide FM, MoCity blends archive and future, culture and club — always in tune with the pulse of the underground.

#ukgarage #electronica #bassmusic #afromusic
